# laravelcloud_caches (Resource)

Manages a cache in Laravel Cloud.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "laravelcloud_caches" "example" {
  auto_upgrade_enabled = false
  is_public            = false
  name                 = "example-name"
  region               = "us-east-2"
  size                 = "250mb"
  type                 = "laravel_valkey"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auto_upgrade_enabled` (Boolean)
- `is_public` (Boolean)
- `name` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `size` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `cache` (String) The cache identifier
- `eviction_policy` (String)
- `hibernation_timeout` (String)
- `uses_hibernation` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import laravelcloud_caches.example the-id
```
